LESSON: OUR NATIONAL FLAG

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social environment
Topic 1.4: Our National Flag
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Our National Flag, part of Social environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: when the Kenya national anthem is sung. 1. Why is the Kenya National flag important? 2. How could we demonstrate respect for the Kenya National flag?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
